Name: Do It For Lance
Author: tigerchatoyance
Description:
Trudging through SVE and the Volcano dungeon for the hundredth time just so you can meet Best Boy? Here is a motivational poster for you to get you through these trying times. You can find the poster in the Furniture Catalogue where the Wall Art is.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]SVE not required because maybe you need some motivation in your vanilla saves too.

This mod was cobbled together using mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41037]Mod Smithy[/url] if that explains any of the funny looking jsons. Feel free to edit it for personal use to your heart's content, though I will say that trying to make it smaller made it lose a lot of details, but maybe I just did it wrong.

I take no credit for the artwork so please don't ask me to make edits or versions of other characters, but I do have permission to post it. Bless the original artist for this miracle for the eyes.
